'''Michael Wokling''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 3rd at [[November 2001 Melbourne tournament (18 November)]] on 18 November 2001 with Revenge beat and 'Inner strength of Poo Cone' (Big Yoda), according to Haakon ".prototype." Geburtstag's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3104">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-17-aim-high-melb-oz-18-11-2001d3104/ aim-high-melb-oz-18-11-2001], DeckTech (Haakon ".prototype." Geburtstag, 17 November 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-17-aim-high-melb-oz-18-11-2001d3104/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
